latest_release.name: v2.25.0
latest_release.body:
## Enhancements

* Go: Upgrade compatibility from 1.24 to 1.25 ([#798](https://github.com/hashicorp/hcl/pull/798))
* hclwrite: Export `LeadComments()`/`LineComments()` ([#807](https://github.com/hashicorp/hcl/pull/807))
* hclwrite: `body.SetAttribute*` return new attribute ([#806](https://github.com/hashicorp/hcl/pull/806))
* hclwrite: `Block.SetType` sets type ([#808](https://github.com/hashicorp/hcl/pull/808))
* Prepare for Unicode 17 support in Go 1.27 ([#814](https://github.com/hashicorp/hcl/pull/814))

## Bug Fixes

* `DiagnosticWriter`: Skip marked values when writing diagnostics ([#739](https://github.com/hashicorp/hcl/pull/739))
* hclsyntax: Set `CloseBraceRange` to last label in error-recovered blocks ([#786](https://github.com/hashicorp/hcl/pull/786))
* hclsyntax: Add partially complete items in nested `ObjectConsItem` on error ([#785](https://github.com/hashicorp/hcl/pull/785))

## Internal

* deps: bump golang.org/x/crypto from 0.38.0 to 0.45.0 ([#774](https://github.com/hashicorp/hcl/pull/774))
